subject: Dedicated capacity architecture deep-dive — scheduling and timezone handoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@orbisai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity architecture deep-dive — scheduling and timezone handoff

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our notes, OrbisAI is interested in a focused technical review on Dedicated GPU capacity so your infra and platform teams can validate sizing, autoscaling behavior, and isolation guarantees before the pilot. Proposed scope:

- Pool sizing & ticketing (expected steady-state v peak)
- Autoscale policy and burst scenarios (latency/throughput tradeoffs)
- Isolation and tenancy/tenant networking options
- Fault/fallback policies and expected SLAs
- Runbook + handoff for pilot (on-call, alerting)

I attached a short draft agenda and the Dedicated Capacity deck for background. Can you confirm who from OrbisAI would join (application owners, cloud infra, and security)? We want to include the right Redwood engineers: I’ve CCd Marissa (acct lead) and Karthik (serving/runtime).

Because you mentioned distributed teams, outlining two candidate slots with timezone conversion:
- Wed Jul 8, 10:00–11:15 PT (13:00–14:15 ET) — 75 mins (recommended)
- Thu Jul 9, 08:00–09:00 PT (11:00–12:00 ET) — 60 mins (high-level only)

If neither works we can shift to an early Europe-friendly time (we can also run two shorter sessions split by topic). Please send preferred attendees and timezone constraints.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-capacity-deck.pdf, draft-deep-dive-agenda.md

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@orbisai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Garcia <tim.garcia@orbisai.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity architecture deep-dive — scheduling and timezone handoff

Ben —

Appreciate the agenda and deck. Tim (cloud infra lead) will join; I’ve also looped in our security mailbox to triage the isolation/networking topics in advance. A couple of notes from our side:

- We’d like a working session that includes concrete workload numbers; I can share a 1-page 95th/99th token throughput snapshot before the meeting.
- The 75-minute Wed slot looks best for our engineers — can we confirm that Karthik and a runtime engineer are available for the full session?
- Our security lead asked whether you could share any SOC2-related artifacts or a short note on data flows ahead of time.

Preferences: Wed Jul 8, 10:00 PT works for us if you can confirm internal attendees and whether the meeting will be recorded. I’m attaching our compliance checklist for context.

Attachments: orbisai-compliance-checklist.pdf

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform
OrbisAI
samantha@orbisai.com | +1 617-555-0233

Thanks Samantha — great, Wed Jul 8, 10:00 PT is locked from our side. I’ve added Priyom (runtime/throughput) and Kimberly (capacity ops) — Priyom will walk through autoscale thresholds and sample telemetry, Kimberly will cover pool isolation and failover behavior. Marissa will run the commercial / logistics portion at the top of the call.

Quick logistics:
- Meeting length: 75 mins (we’ll aim to keep breakouts tight)
- Recorder: yes, we’ll record and share the recording + slide notes afterwards
- Pre-reads: I’ll upload the redwood-deck and a short runbook note to the Drive link below; Samantha — if you can drop your 95th/99th numbers in the same folder, that’ll save 10–15 mins at the top.

Calendar invite: Wed Jul 8, 10:00–11:15 PT — Calendar invite sent (please accept).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDE_example_deck
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/HB-2026-ORBS-42

Looking forward —
Ben
